content.description: In this project we are building a whole universe owned and managed by the users. This virtual world will reinforce cryptocurrency and nft communities by giving them the opportunity to meet and interact together. It will allow creators to build a whole set of new utilities on top of the many existing tokens & coins in the crypto space. One of our objectives is to set a minimum amount of restrictions on the size of the universe. We want the user to be able to build a whole planet and live thousands of light-years away if that's what they want to do.
